name: MKP Mobility Limited
summary: MKP Mobility Limited operates as a global supplier and exporter of automotive components and lubrication products, serving both the Indian domestic market and international territories. The company's comprehensive distribution network also encompasses industrial goods, mechanical and electronic parts, vehicle maintenance items, tires, batteries, and reconditioned components. Founded in 1990, the organization was previously known as Chitradurga Spintex Limited and maintains its headquarters in Pune, India.
